title: Pukka Juice Yellow Pear Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-liquid
description: Yellow Pear Ice from Pukka Juice encapsulates the crispness of ripe Yellow Pear, complemented by a chilling icy undertone. This combination provides a refreshing balance of luscious fruit flavour and invigorating cool with every puff. This premium Pukka Juice e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG ratio offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ unique alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than traditional high-strength, high-PG freebase liquids are capable of. Also, with nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings! If you love this delicious Pukka Juice E-Liquid, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. There is a mouth-watering multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour tastes. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, wicked confectionary and decadent dessert flavours as well as frosty Mint/Menthol blends. Pukka Juice are the award-winning UK vape brand behind some of the most popular e-liquids today. From nic salts, to shortfills and 50/50 eliquids, Pukka Juice do it all with delicious flavours that run the gamut from classic to fiendishly original.
